visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man wearing a light blue button-down shirt standing in a studio designed like a bar. He is positioned in front of a red wall with a bright neon sign reading 'TAIWAN BAR' and shelves filled with various liquor bottles. He holds a black mug in his right hand and points upward with his left hand, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. (2) A simple cartoon avatar of a woman's head appears at the bottom left corner while the man shifts his gaze upward and to the side, maintaining an attentive facial expression. He stands behind a wooden counter with a black mug placed on it. (3) The scene cuts to a woman in a white, sleeveless wedding dress with a high slit, standing in an outdoor courtyard with stone walls. It then cuts back to the man in the bar setting, who is now gesturing with his hands as he speaks. (4) Footage of the Taipei 101 skyscraper is shown against a blue sky with white clouds, followed by a black-and-white historical photo of a dam in a mountainous valley. (5) Aerial footage shows a lush green reservoir area with a red-roofed pavilion and a winding road. This is followed by a dramatic shot of water being forcefully released from a large concrete dam structure. (6) The man returns to the screen, gesturing actively with both hands. A brief shot shows a side view of a person wearing glasses speaking into a large professional microphone in a studio filled with monitors. (7) The final phase shows the man smiling and pointing towards the right side of the frame while variety-style text overlays appear around him. He then looks directly into the camera with a relaxed posture.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video explains the linguistic origin of a common Taiwanese slang phrase used to notify someone their pants zipper is unzipped. It uses a mix of studio talking head, historical footage, and B-roll of landmarks to make the educational content entertaining and easy to digest.
